result.count_method: count of passing-expectation dots on the summary-reporter line of the console log; no failure or skip markers present

oracle: Dense R Laplace marginal likelihood over the joint latent f=(f_1..f_B), eta=X beta+J f, y|f~NB2(mu=exp(eta), size=1/sigma^2), evaluated at the fitted parameters. Written in the test file, uses stats::dnbinom and base linear algebra, no drmTMB code or TMB objective, so it is independent of the likelihood code under test. Not fully independent in fixtures: the phylo covariance is built with drmTMB:::drm_phylo_tip_covariance, and predict()/coef() values from the fit supply the SDs and mu coefficients. It checks likelihood assembly at fitted parameters, not the optimiser.
checks: name-aligned SD predictions equal exp(X alpha) to 1e-8
logLik within 1e-4 of dense Laplace oracle
K vs Q and A vs Ainv logLik 1e-4
tolerances_copied_from_test: oracle 1e-4 absolute logLik; constant-SD 2e-5 relative logLik, 1e-4 mu coef; K/Q and A/Ainv 1e-4 relative; predicted SD vs exp(X alpha) 1e-8; term order 1e-5; SD-slope recovery within 0.6; nested bound 1e-3
